description: Pass/fail limits for npm run eval:renderers (src/renderer_eval.js). parity.min_ssim applies to every frame on the temporal-evidence schedule; min_ssim_all_frames (null = report only) to the per-frame scan of the whole video. duration compares video frame counts with each other and with the story. loudness compares the two renders. audio.max_offset_ms allows the 1024-sample (21.3 ms) AAC priming delay HyperFrames leaves in its mux; max_residual_db applies after aligning that offset. gates: true = must pass, "report" = measured and shown but never fails, false = skipped; motion is enforced: the ambient layer (kit/core/ambient.mjs) keeps settled frames above the cinematic change-energy and flow floors in both renderers. stories.<id> overrides any of these for one golden story; footage allows a -25 dB aligned audio residual because the two renderers resample and mix the base recording's own sound differently (measured -27.6 dB before and after ambient motion).
